processingMetadata: Synthetic offline timestamp/generation from fixture projections; API uses actual committed processing metadata.

definition.grouping: chronological greedy, spatial complete-link, maximum gap and total span; choose smallest maximum distance, then gap, then stable episode id
definition.quickTrade: strictly later reciprocal-team kill; most recent eligible unmatched death, then nearest distance and stable event id; each event used once in either role

killEvents.method: count of observed kill events assigned once by the versioned time/diameter/max-span algorithm

net.method: registered kills minus deaths inside a threshold-defined episode, not a fight outcome or causal advantage

resources.selection: latest timestamp strictly less than episode start; greatest frameIndex breaks equal timestamp ties
